rail.grading.title: Condition grading
rail.grading.m: New, sealed; the media has never been played.
rail.grading.nm: Nearly perfect; barely visible handling marks, no noise.
rail.grading.vgplus: Light scuffs; faint crackle in quiet parts, not distracting.
rail.grading.vg: Noticeable surface noise; plays through without skips.
rail.grading.g: Constant background noise, wear; a player copy, not a shelf piece.
rail.grading.f_p: Serious damage, skips; placeholder until a better copy.
